description: Look up a registered foreign agent in the Foreign Agents Register by registrant name substring, among the published registrants (reviewed institutions active in DOJ's FARA bulk files or listed in DOJ's 2024 and 2025 reports). Returns up to 5 registrants, each with its type, registration and termination dates and status, its active foreign principals from the bulk files (published ones named, withheld ones as a count), and three federal records side by side: the money it reported receiving for its own six-month periods ending in 2024 and in 2025, as DOJ's reports print it, with DOJ's posting dates, by Nature of Services and by principal (DOJ); its Lobbying Disclosure Act filing count for 2025, or "not searched" (lda.gov); and its firm PAC's status and contributions to federal candidates' committees by cycle, with the FEC definitions (FEC). FARA receipts, LDA filing counts and PAC contributions are separate measures, shown side by side and never added. The columns are never read as a sequence. A firm's PAC gives for the whole firm; nothing in the FEC records ties a contribution to any foreign client. No PAC or LDA match is a search result, not a fact about the registrant. Registration under FARA is a legal disclosure, not a finding of wrongdoing; in the Justice Department's words, registration "does not indicate approval by the United States Government of the activities of registered agents". Country strings are DOJ's, as entered by registrants, and are not a statement of U.S. foreign policy. Individuals and single-person firms are withheld and never named or matched.

name.description: Required case-insensitive registrant name substring, at most 80 characters; searched among published registrants only.
